theorem E1 (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ∃ T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)), (∀ I ∈ T, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm I ≤ N) ∧
    (∀ I : Ideal (𝓞 K), I ≠ ⊥ → Ideal.absNorm I ≤ N → I ∈ T) ∧
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      = ∑ I ∈ T, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
  have hfin : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) | I ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm I ≤ N}.Finite := by
    have := (Set.finite_Icc 1 N).biUnion (fun n _ => Ideal.finite_setOf_absNorm_eq (S := 𝓞 K) n)
    refine this.subset (fun I hI => ?_)
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_setOf_eq, mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨Ideal.absNorm I, ⟨?_, hI.2⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff] using hI.1)
  refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro I hI; simpa using hI
  · intro I h1 h2; simpa using ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := hfin.toFinset) (t := Finset.Icc 1 N)
      (g := fun I => Ideal.absNorm I)]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-s))]
      · rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        congr 2
        rw [← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard]
        refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight ?_)
        intro I
        have hn1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).1
        have hn2 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).2
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, mem_setOf_eq]
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact ⟨⟨fun h0 => by rw [h0, Ideal.absNorm_bot] at h; omega, h ▸ hn2⟩, h⟩
        · intro h; exact h.2
      · intro I hI
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hI).2]
    · intro I hI
      have := Set.Finite.mem_toFinset hfin |>.mp hI
      refine Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨?_, this.2⟩
      exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff] using this.1)

theorem zeta_re (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hz : 0 < (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ∧
    (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re = ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, (LSeries.term (fun n : ℕ => ((Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℕ) : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) n).re
      = (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp [LSeries.term, hs.ne', Real.zero_rpow]
    · rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn.ne', ← Complex.ofReal_natCast n, ← Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n),
        ← Complex.ofReal_natCast, ← Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_re, Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
      simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => LSeries.term (fun n : ℕ => ((Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℕ) : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) n) := by
    by_contra h
    have : dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) = 0 := by
      unfold dedekindZeta LSeries
      exact tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable h
    rw [this] at hz; simp at hz
  have h1 := Complex.reCLM.summable hsum
  simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply, hterm] at h1
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  unfold dedekindZeta LSeries
  rw [Complex.re_tsum hsum]
  simp only [hterm]

theorem prime_x_le (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hp : p.IsPrime) (hp0 : p ≠ ⊥) :
    0 ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ∧ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  have h0 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 0 := by simpa [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff] using hp0
  have h1 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 1 := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff]; exact hp.ne_top
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm p)
  refine ⟨Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _, ?_⟩
  calc ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
    _ = ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg_one _
    _ ≤ 2⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) h2
    _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num

theorem euler_bound (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hF : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) (T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hT : ∀ I ∈ T, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ p ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I, p ∈ F) :
    ∑ I ∈ T, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤
      ∏ p ∈ F, (1 - ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s))⁻¹ := by
  set x : Ideal (𝓞 K) → ℝ := fun p => ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) with hxdef
  have hx : ∀ p ∈ F, 0 ≤ x p ∧ x p ≤ 1 / 2 := fun p hp =>
    prime_x_le s hs p (hF p hp).1 (hF p hp).2
  set M := T.sup (fun I => Multiset.card (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I)) with hM
  let e : Ideal (𝓞 K) → (F → ℕ) := fun I p => Multiset.count p.1 (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I)
  have hprod : ∀ I ∈ T, (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).prod = I := fun I hI =>
    associated_iff_eq.mp (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prod_normalizedFactors (hT I hI).1)
  have key1 : ∀ I ∈ T, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) = ∏ p : F, x p.1 ^ e I p := by
    intro I hI
    have hsub : (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).toFinset ⊆ F := fun p hp =>
      (hT I hI).2 p (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hp)
    have h1 : (Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) = ∏ p ∈ F, Ideal.absNorm p ^ Multiset.count p (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hprod I hI]
      rw [Finset.prod_multiset_count_of_subset _ F hsub]
      simp [map_prod, map_pow]
    rw [Finset.prod_coe_sort F (fun p => x p ^ Multiset.count p (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I)), h1]
    push_cast
    rw [← Real.finsetProd_rpow _ _ (fun p _ => by positivity)]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun p _ => ?_)
    simp only [hxdef]
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
      ← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), mul_comm]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn e T := by
    intro I hI J hJ hIJ
    have hc : ∀ p, Multiset.count p (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I) = Multiset.count p (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J) := by
      intro p
      by_cases hp : p ∈ F
      · exact congrFun hIJ ⟨p, hp⟩
      · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun h => hp ((hT I hI).2 p h)),
          Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun h => hp ((hT J hJ).2 p h))]
    rw [← hprod I hI, ← hprod J hJ, Multiset.ext.mpr hc]
  calc ∑ I ∈ T, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      = ∑ I ∈ T, ∏ p : F, x p.1 ^ e I p := Finset.sum_congr rfl key1
    _ = ∑ f ∈ T.image e, ∏ p : F, x p.1 ^ f p := by
        rw [Finset.sum_image hinj]
    _ ≤ ∑ f ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : F => Finset.range (M + 1)), ∏ p : F, x p.1 ^ f p := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun f _ _ => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun p _ => pow_nonneg (hx p.1 p.2).1 _))
        intro f hf
        obtain ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
        rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
        intro p
        rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
        exact (Multiset.count_le_card _ _).trans (Finset.le_sup (f := fun I => Multiset.card (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I)) hI)
    _ = ∏ p : F, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), x p.1 ^ k := by
        rw [Finset.prod_univ_sum]
    _ ≤ ∏ p : F, (1 - x p.1)⁻¹ := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => pow_nonneg (hx p.1 p.2).1 _)) (fun p _ => ?_)
        have hp := hx p.1 p.2
        have hlt : x p.1 < 1 := by linarith [hp.2]
        rw [← tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hp.1 hlt]
        exact (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hp.1 hlt).sum_le_tsum _ (fun k _ => pow_nonneg hp.1 k)
    _ = ∏ p ∈ F, (1 - x p)⁻¹ := Finset.prod_coe_sort F (fun p => (1 - x p)⁻¹)

theorem exp_bound (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1 / 2) : (1 - x)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (x / (1 - x))
  have : (1 - x)⁻¹ = x / (1 - x) + 1 := by field_simp; ring
  rw [this]
  refine h.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * x)]

theorem ideal_sum_le (s : ℝ)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)))
    (G : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (hG : ∀ I ∈ G, I ≠ ⊥) :
    ∑ I ∈ G, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤
      ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
  obtain ⟨T, hT1, hT2, hT3⟩ := E1 (K := K) s (G.sup Ideal.absNorm)
  calc ∑ I ∈ G, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ ∑ I ∈ T, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun _ _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
        intro I hI
        exact hT2 I (hG I hI) (Finset.le_sup (f := Ideal.absNorm) hI)
    _ = _ := hT3.symm
    _ ≤ _ := hsum.sum_le_tsum _ (fun n _ => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))

theorem zeta_le (s s₁ : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hs₁ : 1 ≤ s₁) (h : s₁ ≤ 2 * s)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)))
    (hsum₁ : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s₁))) :
    ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ Real.exp (primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s +
        2 * ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s₁)) := by
  classical
  have hPsum : Summable (fun 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} =>
      ((Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) := by
    refine summable_of_sum_le (c := ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s))
      (fun 𝔭 => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _) (fun G => ?_)
    have := ideal_sum_le s hsum (G.image Subtype.val) (fun I hI => by
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hI
      exact p.2.2.2)
    rwa [Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ h => Subtype.ext h)] at this
  have hb0 : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ (-s) :=
    fun k => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  refine Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le hb0 (fun n => ?_)
  obtain ⟨T, hT1, hT2, hT3⟩ := E1 (K := K) s n
  set F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := T.biUnion (fun I => (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).toFinset) with hFdef
  have hFp : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨I, hI, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hp
    have := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor p (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hp)
    exact ⟨Ideal.isPrime_of_prime this, this.ne_zero⟩
  have hTF : ∀ I ∈ T, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ p ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I, p ∈ F :=
    fun I hI => ⟨(hT1 I hI).1, fun p hp => Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨I, hI, Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hp⟩⟩
  have hb00 : (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = 0} : ℝ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) = 0 := by
    simp [Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : -s ≠ 0)]
  have hxF : ∀ p ∈ F, 0 ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ∧ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    fun p hp => prime_x_le s hs p (hFp p hp).1 (hFp p hp).2
  have hsq : ∀ p ∈ F, (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2 ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s₁) := by
    intro p hp
    have h0 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 0 := by simpa [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff] using (hFp p hp).2
    have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0)
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN1 (by push_cast; linarith)
  have hF1 : ∑ p ∈ F, ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤
      primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s := by
    unfold primeIdealZetaSum
    rw [← Finset.sum_subtype_of_mem (p := fun 𝔭 => 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥)
      (fun p => ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) (s := F) (fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hFp p hp⟩)]
    exact hPsum.sum_le_tsum _ (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have hF2 : ∑ p ∈ F, ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s₁) ≤
      ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s₁) :=
    ideal_sum_le s₁ hsum₁ F (fun p hp => (hFp p hp).2)
  calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 n), (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun k _ _ => hb0 k)
        intro k hk
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
        rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]
        omega
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = k} : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp), hb00, zero_add]
    _ = ∑ I ∈ T, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := hT3
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, (1 - ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s))⁻¹ := euler_bound s hs F hFp T hTF
    _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, Real.exp (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) + 2 * (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p hp => inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith [(hxF p hp).2]))

        (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
    _ ≤ _ := by
        refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]

def primeIdealZetaSum (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
    (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)

def HasDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 δ)

def HasUpperDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  limsup
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

def HasLowerDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  liminf
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

theorem ideal_sum_le_zeta (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s)
    (hsum : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) s)
    (J : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) :
    ∑ I ∈ J.filter (· ≠ ⊥), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by
  set g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)
    with hg
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ, (LSeries.term (fun n ↦ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) n).re = g n := by
    intro n
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp [hg, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : -s ≠ 0)]
    · rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn, hg]
      simp only
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_natCast n, ← Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_natCast, ← Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_re, Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
      simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hgs : Summable g := by
    have := (Complex.reCLM.summable hsum)
    refine this.congr fun n ↦ ?_
    exact hterm n
  have hre : (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re = ∑' n, g n := by
    unfold dedekindZeta LSeries
    rw [Complex.re_tsum hsum]
    exact tsum_congr hterm
  have hg0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n := fun n ↦ by
    simp only [hg]; positivity
  rw [hre]
  have h1 := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := J.filter (· ≠ ⊥)) (t := (J.filter (· ≠ ⊥)).image Ideal.absNorm)
    (g := Ideal.absNorm) (f := fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) ↦ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    (fun I hI ↦ Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hI)
  rw [← h1]
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (g := fun n ↦ g n) fun n hn ↦ ?_) (hgs.sum_le_tsum _ (fun i _ ↦ hg0 i))
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)) (fun I hI ↦ by
    rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hI).2])]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hg]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
  have hfin : Finite {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} :=
    (Ideal.finite_setOfPred_absNorm_eq n).to_subtype
  exact_mod_cast (by
    calc (((J.filter (· ≠ ⊥)).filter fun I ↦ Ideal.absNorm I = n)).card = Nat.card ((((J.filter (· ≠ ⊥)).filter fun I ↦ Ideal.absNorm I = n)) : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) := by
          rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
      _ ≤ Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} :=
        Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.2).2⟩) (fun a b h ↦ Subtype.ext (by simpa using h)))

theorem prod_le_zeta (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 < s)
    (hsum : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) s)
    (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (hF : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) :
    ∏ p ∈ F, (1 + (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ≤ (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.prod_one_add]
  have hprod : ∀ T ∈ F.powerset, ∏ i ∈ T, (Ideal.absNorm i : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      = (Ideal.absNorm (∏ p ∈ T, p) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
    intro T _
    rw [map_prod, Nat.cast_prod, Real.finset_prod_rpow _ _ (fun i _ ↦ Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hprod]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) ↦ ∏ p ∈ T, p) (F.powerset : Set _) := by
    have key : ∀ T ∈ F.powerset, ∀ T' ∈ F.powerset, ∏ p ∈ T, p = ∏ p ∈ T', p → T ⊆ T' := by
      intro T hT T' hT' h p hp
      have hpF := hF p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT hp)
      have hpp : Prime p := Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hpF.2 hpF.1
      have hdvd : p ∣ ∏ q ∈ T', q := h ▸ (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hp)
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finset_prod_iff hpp _).mp hdvd
      have hqF := hF q (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT' hq)
      have hle : q ≤ p := Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp hpq
      have := (Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal hqF.1 hqF.2).eq_of_le hpF.1.ne_top hle
      rwa [← this]
    intro T hT T' hT' h
    exact Finset.Subset.antisymm (key T hT T' hT' h) (key T' hT' T hT h.symm)
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) ↦ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) hinj]
  have hne : ∀ I ∈ F.powerset.image (fun T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) ↦ ∏ p ∈ T, p), I ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro I hI
    obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hI
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun p hp ↦ (hF p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT hp)).2)
  have := ideal_sum_le_zeta K s hs hsum (F.powerset.image (fun T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) ↦ ∏ p ∈ T, p))
  rwa [Finset.filter_true_of_mem hne] at this

theorem one_add_sum_le_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : Finset ι) (y : ι → ℝ) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) :
    1 + ∑ i ∈ F, y i ≤ ∏ i ∈ F, (1 + y i) := by
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a F ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha]
    have := hy a
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ F, y i := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ ↦ hy i
    nlinarith

theorem zeta_summable_eventually :
    ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) s := by
  have hr : ((dedekindZeta_residue K : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (dedekindZeta_residue_pos K).ne'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K).eventually_ne hr] with s hs
  have hz : dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hs
  by_contra hns
  apply hz
  unfold dedekindZeta LSeries
  exact tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hns

theorem sum_upper :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
        (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) + C := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C₂, h₂⟩ := logDedekindZeta_sub_log_inv_sub_one_bounded K
  obtain ⟨s0, hs0, hs0'⟩ := ((zeta_summable_eventually K).and (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2))).exists
  have hsum2 : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    LSeriesSummable.of_re_le_re (by simpa using hs0'.2.le) hs0
  have hZ2nn : 0 ≤ (dedekindZeta K ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ)).re := by
    simpa using ideal_sum_le_zeta K 2 (by norm_num) hsum2 ∅
  refine ⟨|C₂| + (dedekindZeta K ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ)).re, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h₂, zeta_summable_eventually K, Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2)] with s hs₂ hsum hs
  obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := hs
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) := Real.log_nonneg (by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith)
  refine tsum_le_of_sum_le' (by linarith [abs_nonneg C₂]) ?_
  intro F
  have hFp : ∀ q ∈ F.image Subtype.val, q.IsPrime ∧ q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    exact p.2.2
  rw [← Finset.sum_image (f := fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) ↦ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    (fun a _ b _ h ↦ Subtype.ext h)]
  set F' := F.image (Subtype.val : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} → Ideal (𝓞 K)) with hF'
  have hpt : ∀ I ∈ F', (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ Real.log (1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by
    intro I hI
    have hN : (1:ℝ) ≤ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa [Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff] using (hFp I hI).2)
    have hx : 0 ≤ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by positivity
    have h1 : ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2 ≤ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by
      calc ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2 = (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s * 2) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith)]; norm_num
        _ ≤ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hN (by linarith)
    have h2 := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    have h3 : (1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))⁻¹ ≤ 1 - (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) + ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [pow_nonneg hx 3]
    linarith
  have hypos : ∀ I : Ideal (𝓞 K), 0 ≤ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := fun I ↦ by positivity
  have hSy : ∑ I ∈ F', (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) ≤ (dedekindZeta K ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ)).re := by
    have h1 := one_add_sum_le_prod F' (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) ↦ (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ))) hypos
    have h2 := prod_le_zeta K 2 (by norm_num) hsum2 F' hFp
    linarith
  have hprodpos : 0 < ∏ I ∈ F', (1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) :=
    Finset.prod_pos fun I _ ↦ by positivity
  have hlogZ : Real.log (∏ I ∈ F', (1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))) ≤ Real.log (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re :=
    Real.log_le_log hprodpos (prod_le_zeta K s hs1 hsum F' hFp)
  have hb := (abs_le.mp hs₂).2
  calc ∑ I ∈ F', (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ ∑ I ∈ F', (Real.log (1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ))) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
    _ = Real.log (∏ I ∈ F', (1 + (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))) + ∑ I ∈ F', (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-(2:ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Real.log_prod (fun I _ ↦ by positivity)]
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith [le_abs_self C₂]

theorem tendsto_ratio_one_of_log_pm_bounded

  filter_upwards [hL.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with s h
  rw [add_div_eq_mul_add_div _ _ h.ne', one_mul, add_sub_cancel]

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))} {δ : ℝ}

def primeIdealZetaSum (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
    (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)

def HasDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 δ)

def HasUpperDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  limsup
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

def HasLowerDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  liminf
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

section Aux
variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]

def zw (s : ℝ) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ := (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)

lemma zw_mul (s : ℝ) (I J : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : zw K s (I * J) = zw K s I * zw K s J := by
  simp only [zw, map_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
  exact Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

lemma zw_nonneg (s : ℝ) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : 0 ≤ zw K s I := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _

lemma finite_le (N : ℕ) : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) | I ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm I ≤ N}.Finite := by
  refine (Set.Finite.biUnion (Set.finite_Iic N)
    fun n _ => Ideal.finite_setOfPred_absNorm_eq (S := 𝓞 K) n).subset ?_
  intro I ⟨_, h⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨_, h, rfl⟩

def zS (N : ℕ) : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) := (finite_le K N).toFinset

lemma mem_zS (N : ℕ) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : I ∈ zS K N ↔ I ≠ ⊥ ∧ Ideal.absNorm I ≤ N := by
  simp [zS]

def zb (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then 0 else (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)

lemma term_eq (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    LSeries.term (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) n
      = ((zb K s n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [LSeries.term_def, zb]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp
  · rw [show (n : ℂ) = ((n : ℝ) : ℂ) by simp, ← Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
      Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    push_cast
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]

lemma zb_nonneg (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ zb K s n := by
  unfold zb
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)

lemma partial_eq (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), zb K s n = ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := zS K N) (t := Finset.range (N + 1))
    (g := fun I => Ideal.absNorm I)]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have hn' : n ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
    unfold zb
    split_ifs with h0
    · symm
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun I hI => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_zS] at hI
      exact absurd (h0 ▸ hI.2) (fun h => hI.1.1 (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h))
    · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-s))]
      · rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        congr 2
        rw [← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard]
        refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun I => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_zS]
        constructor
        · intro h; exact ⟨⟨fun h' => h0 (by rw [← h, h']; exact Ideal.absNorm_bot) , h ▸ hn'⟩, h⟩
        · exact fun h => h.2
      · intro I hI
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hI
        simp only [zw, hI.2]
  · intro I hI
    rw [mem_zS] at hI
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hI.2)

lemma zw_multiset_prod (s : ℝ) (m : Multiset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) :
    zw K s m.prod = (m.map (zw K s)).prod := by
  induction m using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [zw]
  | cons a m ih => rw [Multiset.prod_cons, zw_mul, ih, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]

lemma zw_finset_prod (s : ℝ) (T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) :
    zw K s (∏ p ∈ T, p) = ∏ p ∈ T, zw K s p := by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on T ?_ ?_
  · simp [zw]
  · intro a T ha ih
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, zw_mul, ih]

lemma one_le_absNorm (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hp : p ≠ ⊥) : 1 ≤ Ideal.absNorm p :=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hp (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h))

lemma prod_one_add_le (s : ℝ) (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (hF : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ N, ∏ p ∈ F, (1 + zw K s p) ≤ ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I := by
  classical
  refine ⟨∏ p ∈ F, Ideal.absNorm p, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.prod_one_add]
  have key : ∀ T ∈ F.powerset,
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (∏ p ∈ T, p) = T.val := by
    intro T hT
    have e : ∏ p ∈ T, p = T.val.prod := (Finset.prod_val T).symm
    rw [e]
    apply UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_prod_of_prime
    intro p hp
    have hpF := hF p (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT hp)
    exact Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hpF.2 hpF.1
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)) => ∏ p ∈ T, p) (F.powerset : Set _) := by
    intro T1 h1 T2 h2 h
    exact Finset.val_inj.mp ((key T1 (Finset.mem_coe.mp h1)).symm.trans
      ((congrArg _ h).trans (key T2 (Finset.mem_coe.mp h2))))
  calc ∑ T ∈ F.powerset, ∏ p ∈ T, zw K s p
      = ∑ T ∈ F.powerset, zw K s (∏ p ∈ T, p) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => ?_
        rw [zw_finset_prod]
    _ = ∑ I ∈ F.powerset.image (fun T => ∏ p ∈ T, p), zw K s I :=
        (Finset.sum_image hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ I ∈ zS K (∏ p ∈ F, Ideal.absNorm p), zw K s I := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun _ _ _ => zw_nonneg K s _)
        intro I hI
        obtain ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hI
        have hTF := Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT
        rw [mem_zS]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← Ideal.zero_eq_bot]
          exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun p hp => by
            rw [Ideal.zero_eq_bot]; exact (hF p (hTF hp)).2
        · rw [map_prod]
          exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Finset.prod_pos fun p hp => one_le_absNorm K p (hF p hp).2)
            (Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ hTF)

lemma nf_facts (N : ℕ) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hI : I ∈ zS K N) (q : Ideal (𝓞 K))
    (hq : q ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I) :
    q.IsPrime ∧ q ≠ ⊥ ∧ 2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm q ∧ Ideal.absNorm q ≤ N := by
  rw [mem_zS] at hI
  have hpr : Prime q := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor q hq
  have hqb : q ≠ ⊥ := hpr.ne_zero
  have hqp : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hpr
  have hdvd : q ∣ I := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hq
  have hposI : 0 < Ideal.absNorm I := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hI.1 (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h))
  refine ⟨hqp, hqb, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : Ideal.absNorm q ≠ 0 := fun h => hqb (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
    have h1 : Ideal.absNorm q ≠ 1 := fun h => hqp.ne_top (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp h)
    omega
  · exact (Nat.le_of_dvd hposI (map_dvd Ideal.absNorm hdvd)).trans hI.2

lemma card_nf_lt (N M : ℕ) (hM : N < 2 ^ M) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hI : I ∈ zS K N) :
    Multiset.card (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I) < M := by
  have hne := ((mem_zS K N I).mp hI).1
  have h1 : (Ideal.absNorm ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).prod))
      = ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).map Ideal.absNorm).prod := map_multiset_prod _ _
  rw [Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hne] at h1
  have h2 : 2 ^ Multiset.card ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).map Ideal.absNorm)
      ≤ ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).map Ideal.absNorm).prod := by
    apply Multiset.pow_card_le_prod
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
    exact (nf_facts K N I hI q hq).2.2.1
  rw [Multiset.card_map, ← h1] at h2
  have h3 := ((mem_zS K N I).mp hI).2
  by_contra hlt
  have hlt' : M ≤ Multiset.card (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I) := not_lt.mp hlt
  have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hlt'
  omega

lemma sum_zS_le (s : ℝ) (N M : ℕ) (hM : N < 2 ^ M) (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hF : ∀ p : Ideal (𝓞 K), p.IsPrime → p ≠ ⊥ → Ideal.absNorm p ≤ N → p ∈ F) :
    ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, zw K s p ^ k := by
  classical
  let g : Ideal (𝓞 K) → (F → ℕ) := fun I p =>
    Multiset.count p.1 (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I)
  have hmemF : ∀ I ∈ zS K N, ∀ q ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I, q ∈ F := by
    intro I hI q hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, _, h4⟩ := nf_facts K N I hI q hq
    exact hF q h1 h2 h4
  have hinj : Set.InjOn g (zS K N : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) := by
    intro I hI J hJ h
    have hI' := Finset.mem_coe.mp hI
    have hJ' := Finset.mem_coe.mp hJ
    have : UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I = UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J := by
      refine Multiset.ext.mpr fun q => ?_
      by_cases hq : q ∈ F
      · exact congrFun h ⟨q, hq⟩
      · have a1 : q ∉ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I := fun hh => hq (hmemF I hI' q hh)
        have a2 : q ∉ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J := fun hh => hq (hmemF J hJ' q hh)
        rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem a1, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem a2]
    rw [← Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self ((mem_zS K N I).mp hI').1,
      ← Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self ((mem_zS K N J).mp hJ').1, this]
  have hw : ∀ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I = ∏ p : F, zw K s p.1 ^ g I p := by
    intro I hI
    have hne := ((mem_zS K N I).mp hI).1
    conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hne]
    rw [zw_multiset_prod, Finset.prod_multiset_map_count]
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (Finset.prod_coe_sort F (fun p => zw K s p ^
      Multiset.count p (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I))).symm
    refine Finset.prod_subset ?_ ?_
    · intro q hq
      exact hmemF I hI q (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hq)
    · intro q _ hq
      rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem (mt Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hq), pow_zero]
  calc ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I = ∑ I ∈ zS K N, ∏ p : F, zw K s p.1 ^ g I p := Finset.sum_congr rfl hw
    _ = ∑ x ∈ (zS K N).image g, ∏ p : F, zw K s p.1 ^ x p :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun x : F → ℕ => ∏ p : F, zw K s p.1 ^ x p) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ x ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : F => Finset.range M), ∏ p : F, zw K s p.1 ^ x p := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun x _ _ =>
          Finset.prod_nonneg fun p _ => pow_nonneg (zw_nonneg K s _) _)
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
        rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
        intro p
        rw [Finset.mem_range]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Multiset.count_le_card _ _) (card_nf_lt K N M hM I hI)
    _ = ∏ p : F, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, zw K s p.1 ^ k :=
        (Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : F => Finset.range M) (fun p k => zw K s p.1 ^ k)).symm
    _ = ∏ p ∈ F, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, zw K s p ^ k :=
        Finset.prod_coe_sort F (fun p => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, zw K s p ^ k)

lemma geom_le_exp (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1 / 2) (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ k ≤ Real.exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := by
  have h1x : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ k ≤ (1 - x)⁻¹ := by
    have e := geom_sum_mul_neg x M
    calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ k = (1 - x ^ M) / (1 - x) := eq_div_of_mul_eq h1x.ne' e
      _ ≤ 1 / (1 - x) := by
          gcongr
          exact sub_le_self _ (pow_nonneg h0 M)
      _ = (1 - x)⁻¹ := one_div _
  have hab := Real.abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le (x := x) (by rw [abs_of_nonneg h0]; linarith) 1
  rw [abs_of_nonneg h0, Finset.sum_range_one] at hab
  have hA : x ^ (0 + 1) / (((0:ℕ):ℝ) + 1) = x := by norm_num
  have hE : x ^ (1 + 1) = x ^ 2 := by norm_num
  rw [hA, hE] at hab
  have hb : x ^ 2 / (1 - x) ≤ 2 * x ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ h1x]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * x)]
  have hlog : -(x + 2 * x ^ 2) ≤ Real.log (1 - x) := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hab).1
    linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(x + 2 * x ^ 2)) ≤ 1 - x :=
    (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog).trans_eq (Real.exp_log h1x)
  calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ k ≤ (1 - x)⁻¹ := hsum
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-(x + 2 * x ^ 2)))⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (Real.exp_pos _) hexp
    _ = Real.exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := by rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_inv]

lemma log_one_add_ge (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ x) : x - x ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (1 + x) := by
  have h := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (x := 1 + x) (by linarith)
  have hp : 0 < 1 + x := by linarith
  have h2 : (1 + x)⁻¹ ≤ 1 - x + x ^ 2 := by
    rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hp]
    nlinarith [pow_nonneg h0 3]
  linarith

lemma two_le_absNorm (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hp : p.IsPrime) (hb : p ≠ ⊥) : 2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm p := by
  have h0 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 0 := fun h => hb (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  have h1 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 1 := fun h => hp.ne_top (Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff.mp h)
  omega

lemma zw_sq_le (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (I : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    zw K s I ^ 2 ≤ zw K 2 I := by
  unfold zw
  have ha : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Ideal.absNorm I := by exact_mod_cast one_le_absNorm K I hI
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith)]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le ha (by push_cast; linarith)

lemma zw_le_half (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hp : p.IsPrime) (hb : p ≠ ⊥) :
    zw K s p ≤ 1 / 2 := by
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Ideal.absNorm p := by exact_mod_cast two_le_absNorm K p hp hb
  calc zw K s p = (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) := rfl
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) h2 (by linarith)
    _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]; norm_num

lemma main_bound (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (Zs Z2 : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ N, ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I ≤ Zs)
    (hB : ∀ B, (∀ N, ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I ≤ B) → Zs ≤ B)
    (hA2 : ∀ N, ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K 2 I ≤ Z2) :
    |Real.log Zs - primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s| ≤ 2 * Z2 := by
  classical
  have hsumT : ∀ (t B : ℝ), (∀ N, ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K t I ≤ B) →
      ∀ T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)), (∀ I ∈ T, I ≠ ⊥) → ∑ I ∈ T, zw K t I ≤ B := by
    intro t B h T hT
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (t := zS K (T.sup Ideal.absNorm)) ?_
      (fun _ _ _ => zw_nonneg K t _)) (h _)
    intro I hI
    rw [mem_zS]
    exact ⟨hT I hI, Finset.le_sup (f := Ideal.absNorm) hI⟩
  have hZ2nn : 0 ≤ Z2 := le_trans (Finset.sum_nonneg fun I _ => zw_nonneg K 2 I) (hA2 0)
  have hZs1 : 1 ≤ Zs := by
    have h1 := hsumT s Zs hA {⊤} (by
      intro I hI; rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hI]; exact top_ne_bot)
    simpa [zw] using h1
  have hsq : ∀ F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)), (∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) →
      ∑ p ∈ F, zw K s p ^ 2 ≤ Z2 := fun F hF =>
    (Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp => zw_sq_le K s hs p (hF p hp).2).trans
      (hsumT 2 Z2 hA2 F fun p hp => (hF p hp).2)
  have hSp : primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s =
      ∑' p : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
        zw K s p.1 := rfl
  have hsumm : Summable (fun p : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) //
      𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} => zw K s p.1) := by
    refine summable_of_sum_le (c := Zs) (fun p => zw_nonneg K s _) ?_
    intro u
    have := Finset.sum_image (f := zw K s) (s := u) (g := Subtype.val)
      (fun a _ b _ h => Subtype.ext h)
    calc _ = ∑ I ∈ u.image Subtype.val, zw K s I := this.symm
      _ ≤ Zs := hsumT s Zs (fun N => hA N) _ (by
          intro I hI
          obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hI
          exact p.2.2.2)
  have hFSp : ∀ F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)), (∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) →
      ∑ p ∈ F, zw K s p ≤ primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s := by
    intro F hF
    rw [hSp, ← Finset.sum_subtype_of_mem
      (p := fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => I ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ I.IsPrime ∧ I ≠ ⊥)
      (fun I => zw K s I) (s := F) (fun x hx => ⟨mem_univ _, hF x hx⟩)]
    exact hsumm.sum_le_tsum _ (fun p _ => zw_nonneg K s _)
  have hLo : ∀ F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)), (∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) →
      ∑ p ∈ F, zw K s p ≤ Real.log Zs + Z2 := by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := prod_one_add_le K s F hF
    have hpos : ∀ p ∈ F, 0 < 1 + zw K s p := fun p _ => by
      have := zw_nonneg K s p; linarith
    have hprod_pos : 0 < ∏ p ∈ F, (1 + zw K s p) := Finset.prod_pos hpos
    have h1 : Real.log (∏ p ∈ F, (1 + zw K s p)) ≤ Real.log Zs :=
      Real.log_le_log hprod_pos (hN.trans (hA N))
    rw [Real.log_prod (fun p hp => (hpos p hp).ne')] at h1
    have h2 : ∑ p ∈ F, (zw K s p - zw K s p ^ 2) ≤ ∑ p ∈ F, Real.log (1 + zw K s p) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => log_one_add_ge _ (zw_nonneg K s p)
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h2
    linarith [hsq F hF]
  have hlo : primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s ≤ Real.log Zs + Z2 := by
    rw [hSp]
    refine hsumm.tsum_le_of_sum_le fun u => ?_
    have := Finset.sum_image (f := zw K s) (s := u) (g := Subtype.val)
      (fun a _ b _ h => Subtype.ext h)
    rw [← this]
    refine hLo _ ?_
    intro I hI
    obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hI
    exact p.2.2
  have hUp : Zs ≤ Real.exp (primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s + 2 * Z2) := by
    refine hB _ fun N => ?_
    set F := (zS K N).filter (fun I => I.IsPrime) with hFdef
    have hFp : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥ := fun p hp => by
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_zS] at hp; exact ⟨hp.2, hp.1.1⟩
    have hFall : ∀ p : Ideal (𝓞 K), p.IsPrime → p ≠ ⊥ → Ideal.absNorm p ≤ N → p ∈ F :=
      fun p h1 h2 h3 => by
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_zS]; exact ⟨⟨h2, h3⟩, h1⟩
    calc ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K s I ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, zw K s p ^ k :=
          sum_zS_le K s N N Nat.lt_two_pow_self F hFall
      _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, Real.exp (zw K s p + 2 * zw K s p ^ 2) :=
          Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => pow_nonneg (zw_nonneg K s p) k)
            (fun p hp => geom_le_exp _ (zw_nonneg K s p)
              (zw_le_half K s hs p (hFp p hp).1 (hFp p hp).2) _)
      _ = Real.exp (∑ p ∈ F, (zw K s p + 2 * zw K s p ^ 2)) := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s + 2 * Z2) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
          linarith [hFSp F hFp, hsq F hFp]
  have hZpos : 0 < Zs := by linarith
  have hlogup : Real.log Zs ≤ primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s + 2 * Z2 :=
    (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hZpos).mpr hUp
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

lemma zeta_facts (t : ℝ)
    (h : LSeriesSummable (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ))
      (t : ℂ)) :
    Summable (zb K t) ∧ (dedekindZeta K (t : ℂ)).re = ∑' n, zb K t n := by
  have h0 : Summable (LSeries.term
      (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) (t : ℂ)) := h
  rw [funext (term_eq K t)] at h0
  have h2 : Summable (zb K t) := Complex.summable_ofReal.mp h0
  refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
  have : dedekindZeta K (t : ℂ) = ((∑' n, zb K t n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
    show LSeries (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) (t : ℂ) = _
    exact tsum_congr (term_eq K t)
  rw [this, Complex.ofReal_re]

lemma zeta_A (t : ℝ) (hsum : Summable (zb K t)) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K t I ≤ ∑' n, zb K t n := by
  rw [← partial_eq K t N]
  exact hsum.sum_le_tsum _ (fun n _ => zb_nonneg K t n)

lemma zeta_B (t B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ N, ∑ I ∈ zS K N, zw K t I ≤ B) : ∑' n, zb K t n ≤ B := by
  refine Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le (fun n => zb_nonneg K t n) fun n => ?_
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, zb K t i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), zb K t i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (Nat.le_succ n)) (fun i _ _ => zb_nonneg K t i)
    _ = _ := partial_eq K t n
    _ ≤ B := hB n

end Aux

theorem logDedekindZeta_sub_primeIdealZetaSum_bounded :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ (s : ℝ) in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), |Real.log (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re
      - primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s| ≤ C := by
  have hr := dedekindZeta_residue_pos K
  have hne : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), ((s : ℂ) - 1) * dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    (tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K).eventually_ne (by exact_mod_cast hr.ne')
  have hev : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), LSeriesSummable
      (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) := by

    by_contra hcon
    apply hs
    have : dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) = 0 := tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hcon
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨s0, hs0, hs0lt⟩ := (hev.and (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2))).exists
  have h2 : LSeriesSummable
      (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) ((2 : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    LSeriesSummable.of_re_le_re (by simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]; exact hs0lt.2.le) hs0
  obtain ⟨hsum2, -⟩ := zeta_facts K 2 h2
  refine ⟨2 * ∑' n, zb K 2 n, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hev, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs hs1
  obtain ⟨hsum, hre⟩ := zeta_facts K s hs
  rw [hre]
  exact main_bound K s (le_of_lt (mem_Ioi.mp hs1)) _ _ (zeta_A K s hsum)
    (fun B hB => zeta_B K s B hB) (zeta_A K 2 hsum2)

theorem logDedekindZeta_sub_log_inv_sub_one_bounded :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ (s : ℝ) in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      |Real.log (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re - Real.log (1 / (s - 1))| ≤ C := by
  set r := dedekindZeta_residue K
  have hrpos : 0 < r := dedekindZeta_residue_pos K
  have hF : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re)
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 r) := by
    refine ((Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp
      (tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K)).congr fun s ↦ ?_
    rw [Function.comp_apply, show ((s : ℂ) - 1) = ((s - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  refine ⟨max |Real.log (r / 2)| |Real.log (2 * r)|, ?_⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re ∈ Ioo (r / 2) (2 * r) :=
    hF.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
  filter_upwards [hev, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hF_s hs1
  simp only [mem_Ioi] at hs1
  have hsm1 : (0 : ℝ) < s - 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hF_s
  have hFpos : (0 : ℝ) < (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by linarith
  have hζpos : (0 : ℝ) < (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hsm1).mp hFpos
  rw [one_div, Real.log_inv, sub_neg_eq_add,
    ← Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hζpos) (ne_of_gt hsm1), mul_comm]

theorem log_minus_bounded_le_primeIdealZetaSum :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),

def primeIdealZetaSum (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
    (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)

def HasDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 δ)

def HasUpperDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  limsup
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

def HasLowerDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  liminf
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

theorem rpow_absNorm_prod (s : ℝ) (m : Multiset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) :
    ((Ideal.absNorm m.prod : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      = (m.map fun p => ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)).prod := by
  induction m using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a m ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons, map_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Multiset.map_cons]
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ih]

open UniqueFactorizationMonoid in
theorem sum_le_prod_geom (s : ℝ) (T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (M : ℕ) (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hF : ∀ I ∈ F, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ (∀ q ∈ normalizedFactors I, q ∈ T) ∧
      ∀ q, Multiset.count q (normalizedFactors I) ≤ M) :
    ∑ I ∈ F, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ ∏ p ∈ T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ k := by
  classical
  set x : Ideal (𝓞 K) → ℝ := fun p => ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) with hx
  have hxnn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ x p := fun p => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _
  let φ : Ideal (𝓞 K) → (T → ℕ) := fun I p => Multiset.count p.1 (normalizedFactors I)
  have h1 : ∀ I ∈ F, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) = ∏ p : T, x p.1 ^ φ I p := by
    intro I hI
    obtain ⟨hI0, hIT, -⟩ := hF I hI
    have hprod : (normalizedFactors I).prod = I :=
      associated_iff_eq.mp (prod_normalizedFactors hI0)
    calc ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
        = ((Ideal.absNorm (normalizedFactors I).prod : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by rw [hprod]
      _ = ((normalizedFactors I).map x).prod := rpow_absNorm_prod K s _
      _ = ∏ p ∈ (normalizedFactors I).toFinset, x p ^ Multiset.count p (normalizedFactors I) :=
          Finset.prod_multiset_map_count _ _
      _ = ∏ p ∈ T, x p ^ Multiset.count p (normalizedFactors I) := by
          apply Finset.prod_subset
          · intro q hq; exact hIT q (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hq)
          · intro q _ hq
            rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun h => hq (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr h))]; simp
      _ = ∏ p : T, x p.1 ^ φ I p :=
          (Finset.prod_coe_sort T (fun p => x p ^ Multiset.count p (normalizedFactors I))).symm
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φ F := by
    intro I hI J hJ hIJ
    obtain ⟨hI0, hIT, -⟩ := hF I hI
    obtain ⟨hJ0, hJT, -⟩ := hF J hJ
    have : normalizedFactors I = normalizedFactors J := by
      refine Multiset.ext.mpr fun a => ?_
      by_cases ha : a ∈ T
      · exact congrFun hIJ ⟨a, ha⟩
      · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun h => ha (hIT a h)),
          Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun h => ha (hJT a h))]
    rw [← associated_iff_eq.mp (prod_normalizedFactors hI0),
      ← associated_iff_eq.mp (prod_normalizedFactors hJ0), this]
  have hR : ∏ p ∈ T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), x p ^ k
      = ∑ e ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : T => Finset.range (M + 1)), ∏ p : T, x p.1 ^ e p := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_coe_sort T (fun p => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), x p ^ k)]
    exact Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : T => Finset.range (M + 1)) (fun p k => x p.1 ^ k)
  show _ ≤ ∏ p ∈ T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), x p ^ k
  rw [hR, Finset.sum_congr rfl h1]
  calc ∑ I ∈ F, ∏ p : T, x p.1 ^ φ I p
      = ∑ e ∈ F.image φ, ∏ p : T, x p.1 ^ e p :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun e : T → ℕ => ∏ p : T, x p.1 ^ e p) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        · intro e he
          obtain ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
          simp only [Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_range]
          intro p
          exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((hF I hI).2.2 _)
        · intro e _ _
          exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun p _ => pow_nonneg (hxnn _) _

theorem mem_idealsLE {N : ℕ} {I : Ideal (𝓞 K)} :

theorem two_le_absNorm {q : Ideal (𝓞 K)} (h0 : q ≠ ⊥) (hp : q.IsPrime) :
    2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm q := by
  have h1 : Ideal.absNorm q ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h)

theorem inv_one_sub_le_exp (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (1 - x)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  calc (1 - x)⁻¹ = x / (1 - x) + 1 := by field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ Real.exp (x / (1 - x)) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
    _ ≤ Real.exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2 * x)])

theorem partial_bound (s : ℝ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ I ∈ idealsLE K N, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ Real.exp (∑ p ∈ primesLE K N, ((((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s))
          + 2 * (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2)) := by
  have hmem : ∀ I ∈ idealsLE K N, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ (∀ q ∈ normalizedFactors I, q ∈ primesLE K N) ∧
      ∀ q, Multiset.count q (normalizedFactors I) ≤ N := by
    intro I hI
    obtain ⟨hIN, hI0⟩ := (mem_idealsLE K).mp hI
    have hIpos : 0 < Ideal.absNorm I := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => hI0 (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
    refine ⟨hI0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq
      have hqp : Prime q := prime_of_normalized_factor q hq
      have hq0 : q ≠ ⊥ := hqp.ne_zero
      have hqdvd : q ∣ I := dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hq
      have := Ideal.absNorm_dvd_absNorm_of_le (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mp hqdvd)
      exact (mem_primesLE K).mpr ⟨⟨(Nat.le_of_dvd hIpos this).trans hIN, hq0⟩, Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hqp⟩
    · intro q
      have hprod : (normalizedFactors I).prod = I :=
        associated_iff_eq.mp (prod_normalizedFactors hI0)
      have hge : ∀ a ∈ (normalizedFactors I).map (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p), 2 ≤ a := by
        intro a ha
        obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp ha
        exact two_le_absNorm K (prime_of_normalized_factor p hp).ne_zero
          (Ideal.isPrime_of_prime (prime_of_normalized_factor p hp))
      have h1 : 2 ^ Multiset.card ((normalizedFactors I).map (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p))
          ≤ ((normalizedFactors I).map (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p)).prod :=
        Multiset.pow_card_le_prod hge
      rw [Multiset.card_map, ← map_multiset_prod, hprod] at h1
      have h2 := Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := Multiset.card (normalizedFactors I))
      have h3 := Multiset.count_le_card q (normalizedFactors I)
      omega
  refine (sum_le_prod_geom K s _ N _ hmem).trans ?_
  rw [Real.exp_sum]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  · intro p _
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => pow_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _) _
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hp0⟩, hpp⟩ := (mem_primesLE K).mp hp
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast two_le_absNorm K hp0 hpp
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _
    have hx1 : ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      calc ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by norm_num) h2 (by linarith)
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        _ = 1 / 2 := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]; norm_num
    refine le_trans ?_ (inv_one_sub_le_exp _ hx0 hx1)
    have hlt : ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) < 1 := by linarith
    calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ k
        ≤ ∑' k : ℕ, (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ k :=
          (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hx0 hlt).sum_le_tsum _ (fun _ _ => pow_nonneg hx0 _)
      _ = (1 - ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s))⁻¹ := tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hx0 hlt

noncomputable def zetaTerm (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then 0 else (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)

theorem sum_zetaTerm (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), zetaTerm K s n
      = ∑ I ∈ idealsLE K N, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := idealsLE K N) (t := Finset.range (N + 1))
    (g := fun I => Ideal.absNorm I) (fun I hI => by
      have := ((mem_idealsLE K).mp hI).1
      simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using this)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
  have hnN : n ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · subst h0
    simp only [zetaTerm, if_true]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro I hI
    obtain ⟨hI1, hI2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hI
    exact absurd (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp hI2) ((mem_idealsLE K).mp hI1).2
  · simp only [zetaTerm, h0, if_false]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)) (fun I hI => by
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hI).2]), Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 2
    have : (↑((idealsLE K N).filter (fun I => Ideal.absNorm I = n)) : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
        = {I | Ideal.absNorm I = n} := by
      ext I
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, mem_idealsLE, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      constructor
      · exact fun h => h.2
      · intro h
        exact ⟨⟨h ▸ hnN, fun h' => h0 (by rw [← h, h', Ideal.absNorm_bot])⟩, h⟩
    rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset, this, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    rfl

theorem dedekindZeta_eq_tsum (s : ℝ) :
    dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) = ((∑' n, zetaTerm K s n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
  unfold dedekindZeta LSeries
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [LSeries.term_def]
  unfold zetaTerm
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · simp [h0]
  · simp only [h0, if_false]
    push_cast
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.cpow_neg,
      div_eq_mul_inv, Complex.ofReal_natCast]

theorem logDedekindZeta_sub_log_inv_sub_one_bounded :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ (s : ℝ) in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      |Real.log (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re - Real.log (1 / (s - 1))| ≤ C := by
  set r := dedekindZeta_residue K
  have hrpos : 0 < r := dedekindZeta_residue_pos K
  have hF : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re)
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 r) := by
    refine ((Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp
      (tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K)).congr fun s ↦ ?_
    rw [Function.comp_apply, show ((s : ℂ) - 1) = ((s - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  refine ⟨max |Real.log (r / 2)| |Real.log (2 * r)|, ?_⟩
  have hev : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re ∈ Ioo (r / 2) (2 * r) :=
    hF.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
  filter_upwards [hev, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hF_s hs1
  simp only [mem_Ioi] at hs1
  have hsm1 : (0 : ℝ) < s - 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hF_s
  have hFpos : (0 : ℝ) < (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by linarith
  have hζpos : (0 : ℝ) < (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hsm1).mp hFpos
  rw [one_div, Real.log_inv, sub_neg_eq_add,
    ← Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hζpos) (ne_of_gt hsm1), mul_comm]
  exact abs_le_max_abs_abs (Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) hlo).le (Real.log_lt_log hFpos hhi).le

theorem zetaTerm_nonneg (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ zetaTerm K s n := by
  unfold zetaTerm
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)

theorem finset_sum_le_zeta (s : ℝ) (hsum : Summable (zetaTerm K s)) (G : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hG : ∀ I ∈ G, I ≠ ⊥) :
    ∑ I ∈ G, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n := by
  classical
  set N := G.sup (fun I => Ideal.absNorm I)
  have hsub : G ⊆ idealsLE K N := by
    intro I hI
    exact (mem_idealsLE K).mpr ⟨Finset.le_sup (f := fun I => Ideal.absNorm I) hI, hG I hI⟩
  calc ∑ I ∈ G, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ ∑ I ∈ idealsLE K N, ((Ideal.absNorm I : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
          (fun _ _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), zetaTerm K s n := (sum_zetaTerm K s N).symm
    _ ≤ ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n := hsum.sum_le_tsum _ (fun n _ => zetaTerm_nonneg K s n)

theorem log_minus_bounded_le_primeIdealZetaSum :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) - C
        ≤ primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C₂, h₂⟩ := logDedekindZeta_sub_log_inv_sub_one_bounded K
  have hZ : ∀ s : ℝ, (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re = ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n := by
    intro s; rw [dedekindZeta_eq_tsum, Complex.ofReal_re]
  set r := dedekindZeta_residue K
  have hrpos : 0 < r := dedekindZeta_residue_pos K
  have hF : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re)
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 r) := by
    refine ((Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp
      (tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K)).congr fun s ↦ ?_
    rw [Function.comp_apply, show ((s : ℂ) - 1) = ((s - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), 0 < ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n := by
    filter_upwards [hF.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (half_lt_self hrpos)), self_mem_nhdsWithin]
      with s hs hs1
    have hsm1 : (0 : ℝ) < s - 1 := by simp only [mem_Ioi] at hs1; linarith
    rw [← hZ]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by
      have h' : r / 2 < (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := hs
      linarith
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hsm1).mp this
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hsubu⟩ := (mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset).mp hpos
  have hu1 : (1 : ℝ) < u := hu
  set s0 : ℝ := (1 + min u 2) / 2 with hs0
  have hmin1 : 1 < min u 2 := lt_min hu1 (by norm_num)
  have hs0u : s0 < u := by have := min_le_left u 2; rw [hs0]; linarith
  have hs02 : s0 < 2 := by have := min_le_right u 2; rw [hs0]; linarith
  have hs01 : 1 < s0 := by rw [hs0]; linarith
  have hsummable : ∀ s ∈ Ioo (1 : ℝ) u, Summable (zetaTerm K s) := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra h
    have := hsubu hs
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at this
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable h] at this
    exact lt_irrefl _ this
  have hs0sum : Summable (zetaTerm K s0) := hsummable s0 ⟨hs01, hs0u⟩
  set B := ∑' n, zetaTerm K s0 n with hB
  refine ⟨C₂ + 2 * B, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h₂, Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hs01] with s hs₂ hs
  obtain ⟨hs1, hss0⟩ := hs
  have hssum : Summable (zetaTerm K s) := hsummable s ⟨hs1, hss0.trans hs0u⟩
  have hZpos : 0 < ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n := hsubu ⟨hs1, hss0.trans hs0u⟩
  have hPsum : Summable (fun p : {p : Ideal (𝓞 K) // p ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥} =>
      ((Ideal.absNorm p.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) := by
    refine summable_of_sum_le (c := ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n)
      (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _) fun v => ?_
    have h := finset_sum_le_zeta K s hssum (v.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _)) (by
      intro I hI
      obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hI
      exact q.2.2.2)
    rwa [Finset.sum_map] at h
  have hsumP : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ p ∈ primesLE K N, ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s := by
    intro N
    have hsub : ((primesLE K N).subtype (fun p : Ideal (𝓞 K) =>
        p ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥)).map (Function.Embedding.subtype _)
        = primesLE K N := by
      rw [Finset.subtype_map]
      apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨⟨-, hp0⟩, hpp⟩ := (mem_primesLE K).mp hp
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, hpp, hp0⟩
    rw [← hsub, Finset.sum_map]
    exact hPsum.sum_le_tsum _ (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have hsumB : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ p ∈ primesLE K N, (((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2 ≤ B := by
    intro N
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp => ?_)
      (finset_sum_le_zeta K s0 hs0sum (primesLE K N) (fun I hI => ((mem_primesLE K).mp hI).1.2))
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hp0⟩, hpp⟩ := (mem_primesLE K).mp hp
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (by have := two_le_absNorm K hp0 hpp; omega : 1 ≤ Ideal.absNorm p)
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1 (by push_cast; linarith)
  have hle : ∑' n, zetaTerm K s n
      ≤ Real.exp (primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s + 2 * B) := by
    refine Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le (fun n => zetaTerm_nonneg K s n) fun N => ?_
    rcases N with _ | m
    · simpa using (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · rw [sum_zetaTerm]
      refine (partial_bound K s hs1.le m).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      linarith [hsumP m, hsumB m]
  have hlog : Real.log (∑' n, zetaTerm K s n)
      ≤ primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s + 2 * B :=
    (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hZpos).mpr hle
  rw [hZ] at hs₂
  linarith [(abs_le.mp hs₂).1]

    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ Real.log (1 / (s - 1))) (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) atTop := by
  refine Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp ?_
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ s - 1) (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) := by
    refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ ?_ ?_
    · exact ((continuous_sub_right 1).tendsto' 1 0 (by ring)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hs ⊢
      linarith
  simpa only [one_div] using! h1.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero

theorem tendsto_ratio_one_of_log_pm_bounded
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (h_le : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), f s ≤ Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) + C)
    (h_lower : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) - C ≤ f s) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ f s / Real.log (1 / (s - 1))) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1) := by
  obtain ⟨C₁, hle⟩ := h_le
  obtain ⟨C₂, hlower⟩ := h_lower
  have hL := tendsto_log_one_div_sub_one_atTop
  have h0 : Tendsto (fun s ↦ (f s - Real.log (1 / (s - 1))) / Real.log (1 / (s - 1)))
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_bdd_div_atTop_nhds_zero (b := -C₂) (B := C₁)
      (hlower.mono fun s h ↦ by linarith) (hle.mono fun s h ↦ by linarith) hL
  refine (add_zero (1 : ℝ) ▸ h0.const_add 1).congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hL.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with s h
  rw [add_div_eq_mul_add_div _ _ h.ne', one_mul, add_sub_cancel]
