namespace Chebotarev

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))} {δ : ℝ}

def primeIdealZetaSum (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
    (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)

theorem primeIdealZetaSum_def (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (s : ℝ) :
    primeIdealZetaSum S s =
      ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
        (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s) := rfl

def HasDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 δ)

def HasUpperDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  limsup
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

def HasLowerDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  liminf
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

lemma absNorm_ge_two {p : Ideal (𝓞 K)} (hp : p.IsPrime) (hne : p ≠ ⊥) :
    2 ≤ Ideal.absNorm p := by
  have h0 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 0 := by rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]; exact hne
  have h1 : Ideal.absNorm p ≠ 1 := by rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_one_iff]; exact hp.ne_top
  omega

lemma inv_one_sub_le_exp {x : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (1 - x)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
  have : (1 - x)⁻¹ ≤ 1 + (x + 2 * x ^ 2) := by
    rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hpos]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - 2 * x)]
  exact this.trans (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (x + 2 * x ^ 2)])

lemma geom_le_inv {y : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ y) (h1 : y < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, y ^ k ≤ (1 - y)⁻¹ := by
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - y := by linarith
  rw [inv_eq_one_div, le_div_iff₀ hpos]
  have := mul_neg_geom_sum y n
  rw [mul_comm, this]
  linarith [pow_nonneg h0 n]

lemma finite_sum_le_prod (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hF : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) (T : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hT : ∀ I ∈ T, I ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ p ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I, p ∈ F) :
    ∑ I ∈ T, (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, (1 - (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s))⁻¹ := by
  classical
  set x : Ideal (𝓞 K) → ℝ := fun p => (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) with hx
  have hx0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ x p := fun p => by simp only [hx]; positivity
  have hx1 : ∀ p ∈ F, x p < 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have h2 := absNorm_ge_two (hF p hp).1 (hF p hp).2
    exact Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < Ideal.absNorm p))
      (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : Ideal (𝓞 K) → F → ℕ, ∀ I p,
      E I p = (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count p.1 :=
    ⟨fun I p => (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).count p.1, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hrep : ∀ I ∈ T, I = ∏ p : F, (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ^ (E I p) := by
    intro I hI
    obtain ⟨hI0, hIF⟩ := hT I hI
    have h1 := Ideal.prod_normalizedFactors_eq_self hI0
    set m := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I with hm
    calc I = m.prod := h1.symm
      _ = ∏ p ∈ m.toFinset, p ^ m.count p := Finset.prod_multiset_count _
      _ = ∏ p ∈ F, p ^ m.count p := by
        refine Finset.prod_subset (fun p hp => hIF p (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hp)) ?_
        intro p _ hp
        rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem (fun h => hp (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr h)), pow_zero]
      _ = ∏ p : F, (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ^ (E I p) := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_coe_sort F (fun p => p ^ m.count p)]
        simp only [hE]
        rfl
  have hxprod : ∀ I ∈ T, x I = ∏ p : F, x p ^ E I p := by
    intro I hI
    have h := congrArg Ideal.absNorm (hrep I hI)
    rw [map_prod] at h
    simp only [map_pow] at h
    have h' : (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) = ∏ p : F, (Ideal.absNorm (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ) ^ E I p := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    simp only [hx]
    rw [h', ← Real.finset_prod_rpow _ _ (fun p _ => by positivity)]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity),
      ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), mul_comm]
  have hinj : ∀ I ∈ T, ∀ J ∈ T, E I = E J → I = J := by
    intro I hI J hJ h
    calc I = ∏ p : F, (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ^ (E I p) := hrep I hI
      _ = ∏ p : F, (p : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ^ (E J p) := by rw [h]
      _ = J := (hrep J hJ).symm
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, ∀ I ∈ T, ∀ p, E I p ≤ M :=
    ⟨T.sup fun I => Finset.univ.sup (E I), fun I hI p =>
      (Finset.le_sup (f := E I) (Finset.mem_univ p)).trans
        (Finset.le_sup (f := fun I => Finset.univ.sup (E I)) hI)⟩
  calc ∑ I ∈ T, x I = ∑ I ∈ T, ∏ p : F, x p ^ E I p := Finset.sum_congr rfl hxprod
    _ = ∑ f ∈ T.image (fun I => E I), ∏ p : F, x p ^ f p :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun f : F → ℕ => ∏ p : F, x p ^ f p)
          (fun I hI J hJ h => hinj I hI J hJ h)).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ f ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun _ : F => Finset.range (M + 1)), ∏ p : F, x p ^ f p := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
        · intro f hf
          obtain ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
          rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
          intro p
          exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hM I hI p))
        · intro f _ _
          exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun p _ => pow_nonneg (hx0 p) _
    _ = ∏ p : F, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), x p ^ k :=
        (Finset.prod_univ_sum (fun _ : F => Finset.range (M + 1)) (fun p k => x p ^ k)).symm
    _ ≤ ∏ p : F, (1 - x p)⁻¹ :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => pow_nonneg (hx0 p) _)
          (fun p _ => geom_le_inv (hx0 p) (hx1 p p.2) _)
    _ = ∏ p ∈ F, (1 - x p)⁻¹ := Finset.prod_coe_sort F (fun p => (1 - x p)⁻¹)

lemma zeta_eq_tsum {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) = ((∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ)
      * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  unfold NumberField.dedekindZeta LSeries
  rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
  congr 1
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn
    simp [LSeries.term, Real.zero_rpow (neg_ne_zero.mpr hs.ne')]
  · rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn]
    push_cast
    rw [Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Complex.ofReal_inv, Complex.ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

lemma summable_ideal_of_summable {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hg : Summable fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ)
      * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s)) :
    Summable (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ∧
    ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
  let e := Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => Ideal.absNorm I)
  have hfin : ∀ n : ℕ, Finite {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} := by
    intro n
    exact (Ideal.finite_setOf_absNorm_eq n).to_subtype
  have hF : ∀ (p : Σ n : ℕ, {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n}),
      (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) (e p) = (p.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
    rintro ⟨n, I, hI⟩
    simp [e, hI]
  have hfib : ∀ n : ℕ, ∑' I : {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n},
      (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) (e ⟨n, I⟩) =
      (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
    intro n
    simp only [hF]
    rw [tsum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ∘ e :=
    fun p => by simp only [Function.comp]; positivity
  have hsum : Summable ((fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ∘ e) := by
    rw [summable_sigma_of_nonneg hnn]
    refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
    · haveI := hfin n
      exact Summable.of_finite
    · simpa only [Function.comp, hfib] using hg
  refine ⟨(e.summable_iff).mp hsum, ?_⟩
  rw [← e.tsum_eq]
  exact (Summable.tsum_sigma' (fun n => by haveI := hfin n; exact Summable.of_finite) hsum).trans
    (tsum_congr hfib)

lemma residue_tendsto (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ (s - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re)
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (dedekindZeta_residue K)) := by
  refine ((Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp
    (tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K)).congr fun s ↦ ?_
  rw [Function.comp_apply, show ((s : ℂ) - 1) = ((s - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
    Complex.re_ofReal_mul]

lemma summable_g {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    Summable fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ)
      * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
  have hrpos := dedekindZeta_residue_pos K
  have hF := residue_tendsto K
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      (t - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (t : ℂ)).re ∈ Ioo (dedekindZeta_residue K / 2)
        (2 * dedekindZeta_residue K) :=
    hF.eventually (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨hlo, hhi⟩, ht⟩ := (hev.and (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hs)).exists
  have ht1 : 1 < t := ht.1
  have hts : t < s := ht.2
  have hre : 0 < (dedekindZeta K (t : ℂ)).re := by
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < (t - 1) * (dedekindZeta K (t : ℂ)).re := by linarith
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (by linarith)).mp hp
  rw [zeta_eq_tsum (by linarith), Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
  have hsumt : Summable fun n : ℕ => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ)
      * (n : ℝ) ^ (-t) := by
    by_contra h
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable h] at hre
    exact lt_irrefl _ hre
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) hsumt
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn
    simp [Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : -s ≠ 0), Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : -t ≠ 0)]
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (Nat.one_le_cast.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn))
        (by linarith)) (by positivity)

lemma tsum_ideal_eq_re {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    Summable (fun I : Ideal (𝓞 K) => (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ∧
    ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) = (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := summable_ideal_of_summable (K := K) (by linarith) (summable_g hs)
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [h2, zeta_eq_tsum (by linarith), Complex.ofReal_re]

lemma sum_le_primeSum {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (F : Finset (Ideal (𝓞 K)))
    (hF : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥) :
    ∑ p ∈ F, (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-t) ≤
      primeIdealZetaSum (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) t := by
  classical
  have hsum : Summable (fun p : {p : Ideal (𝓞 K) // p ∈ (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧
      p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥} => (Ideal.absNorm p.1 : ℝ) ^ (-t)) :=
    (tsum_ideal_eq_re (K := K) ht).1.comp_injective Subtype.val_injective
  have := Summable.sum_le_tsum (F.subtype (fun p => p ∈ (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧
      p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥)) (fun _ _ => by positivity) hsum
  rw [Finset.sum_subtype_of_mem (fun p => (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-t))
    (fun p hp => ⟨mem_univ _, hF p hp⟩)] at this
  exact this

lemma tsum_ideal_le {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤
      Real.exp (primeIdealZetaSum (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s +
        2 * primeIdealZetaSum (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) 2) := by
  classical
  refine tsum_le_of_sum_le' (Real.exp_pos _).le (fun T => ?_)
  set T' := T.filter (· ≠ ⊥) with hT'def
  set F := T'.biUnion fun I => (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I).toFinset with hFdef
  have hFp : ∀ p ∈ F, p.IsPrime ∧ p ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨I, _, hpI⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hp
    have hpr := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor p
      (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hpI)
    exact ⟨Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hpr, by rw [← Ideal.zero_eq_bot]; exact hpr.ne_zero⟩
  have hT' : ∀ I ∈ T', I ≠ ⊥ ∧ ∀ p ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors I, p ∈ F := by
    intro I hI
    exact ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hI).2, fun p hp =>
      Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨I, hI, Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hp⟩⟩
  have hTT : ∑ I ∈ T', (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) = ∑ I ∈ T, (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
    apply Finset.sum_filter_of_ne
    intro I _ hne hI
    apply hne
    rw [hI, Ideal.absNorm_bot]
    simp [Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : -s ≠ 0)]
  rw [← hTT]
  refine (finite_sum_le_prod s (by linarith) F hFp T' hT').trans ?_
  have hxb : ∀ p ∈ F, 0 ≤ (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) ∧
      (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro p hp
    have h2 := absNorm_ge_two (hFp p hp).1 (hFp p hp).2
    have hN2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    calc (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) ≤ (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
      _ = (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ)⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg_one _
      _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [inv_eq_one_div]; exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hN2
  have hsq : ∀ p ∈ F, ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2 ≤ (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-2 : ℝ) := by
    intro p hp
    have h2 := absNorm_ge_two (hFp p hp).1 (hFp p hp).2
    have hN2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by push_cast; linarith)
  calc ∏ p ∈ F, (1 - (Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s))⁻¹
      ≤ ∏ p ∈ F, Real.exp ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) + 2 * ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun p hp => inv_nonneg.mpr (by linarith [(hxb p hp).2]))
          (fun p hp => inv_one_sub_le_exp (hxb p hp).1 (hxb p hp).2)
    _ = Real.exp (∑ p ∈ F, ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s) + 2 * ((Ideal.absNorm p : ℝ) ^ (-s)) ^ 2)) :=
        (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
    _ ≤ _ := by
        refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        exact add_le_add (sum_le_primeSum hs F hFp)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            ((Finset.sum_le_sum hsq).trans (sum_le_primeSum (by norm_num) F hFp)) (by norm_num))

theorem tendsto_atTop_main :
    Tendsto (primeIdealZetaSum (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K)))) (𝓝[>] 1) atTop := by
  have hrpos := dedekindZeta_residue_pos K
  have hF := residue_tendsto K
  have hZ : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ),
      ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s) = (dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)).re := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    exact (tsum_ideal_eq_re (K := K) hs).2
  have hF' : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ (s - 1) * ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (dedekindZeta_residue K)) :=
    hF.congr' (by filter_upwards [hZ] with s hs; rw [hs])
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ s - 1) (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) := by
    refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ ?_ ?_
    · exact ((continuous_sub_right 1).tendsto' 1 0 (by ring)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hs ⊢
      linarith
  have hinv := h1.inv_tendsto_nhdsGT_zero
  have hZt : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s))
      (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ)) atTop := by
    refine (hF'.pos_mul_atTop hrpos hinv).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have : s - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < s := hs
      linarith
    change ((s - 1) * ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)) * (s - 1)⁻¹ =
      ∑' I : Ideal (𝓞 K), (Ideal.absNorm I : ℝ) ^ (-s)
    field_simp
  have hlog := Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp hZt
  have hlog' := tendsto_atTop_add_const_right (𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ))
    (-(2 * primeIdealZetaSum (Set.univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) 2)) hlog
  refine tendsto_atTop_mono' _ ?_ hlog'
  filter_upwards [hZt.eventually_gt_atTop 0, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hpos hs
  have hs1 : (1 : ℝ) < s := hs
  have := (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hpos).mpr (tsum_ideal_le (K := K) hs1)
  simp only [Function.comp]
  linarith

variable (K)

/-- The full prime-ideal zeta sum diverges to `+∞` as `s ↓ 1`. -/
theorem primeIdealZetaSum_univ_tendsto_atTop :
    Tendsto (primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K)))) (𝓝[>] 1) atTop :=
  tendsto_atTop_main

theorem primeIdealZetaSum_le_card_of_finite (hS : S.Finite)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    primeIdealZetaSum S s ≤
      Nat.card {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} := by
  have : Finite {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} :=
    (hS.subset fun _ hx ↦ hx.1).to_subtype
  have : Fintype {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [primeIdealZetaSum_def, tsum_fintype, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc ∑ 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
        (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)
      ≤ ∑ _𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥}, (1 : ℝ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun 𝔭 _ ↦ Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos ?_ (by linarith)
        exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
          (by rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]; exact 𝔭.2.2.2)
    _ = (Fintype.card {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} : ℝ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Chebotarev.hasDirichletDensity_univ
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun s ↦ primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s
    / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 1)
  refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [primeIdealZetaSum_univ_pos_eventually K] with s hs
  exact (div_self hs.ne').symm

namespace Chebotarev

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))} {δ : ℝ}

def primeIdealZetaSum (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ S ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥},
    (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)

def HasDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  Tendsto
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 δ)

def HasUpperDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  limsup
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

def HasLowerDirichletDensity (S : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) (δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  liminf
    (fun s : ℝ ↦ primeIdealZetaSum S s / primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s)
    (𝓝[>] 1) = δ

variable (K)

theorem summable_aux (s : ℝ)
    (h : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ ((Nat.card { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n } : ℕ) : ℂ)) (s : ℂ)) :
    Summable (fun 𝔭 : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} =>
      (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1 : ℝ) ^ (-s)) := by
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ‖LSeries.term (fun n ↦ ((Nat.card { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n } : ℕ) : ℂ)) (s:ℂ) n‖ with hf
  have hfs : Summable f := h.norm
  have hf0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n := fun n => norm_nonneg _
  have hfn : ∀ n, n ≠ 0 → f n = (Nat.card { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n } : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
    intro n hn
    simp only [hf, LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn, norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast]
    rw [Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), Complex.ofReal_re, Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine summable_of_sum_le (c := ∑' n, f n) (fun _ => by positivity) ?_
  intro F
  have hpos : ∀ p : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭 ∈ (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) ∧ 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥}, Ideal.absNorm p.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro p
    rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]; exact p.2.2.2
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (s := F) (t := F.image (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p.1)) (g := fun p => Ideal.absNorm p.1)
    (fun p hp => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)]
  calc _ = ∑ n ∈ F.image (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p.1),
        ((F.filter (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p.1 = n)).card : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ (-s) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun _ => (n : ℝ) ^ (-s))]
        · simp
        · intro p hp
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2]
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ F.image (fun p => Ideal.absNorm p.1), f n := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn => ?_
        obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hn
        rw [hfn _ (hpos p)]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
        have hfin : Finite { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = Ideal.absNorm p.1 } :=
          (Ideal.finite_setOfPred_absNorm_eq _).to_subtype
        have : (F.filter (fun q => Ideal.absNorm q.1 = Ideal.absNorm p.1)).card ≤
            Nat.card { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = Ideal.absNorm p.1 } := by
          rw [← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard]
          refine Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
            (fun x => ⟨x.1.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp x.2).2⟩) ?_
          intro x y hxy
          have h2 : x.1.1 = y.1.1 := Subtype.mk.inj hxy
          exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h2)
        exact_mod_cast this
    _ ≤ ∑' n, f n := hfs.sum_le_tsum _ (fun n _ => hf0 n)

theorem primeIdealZetaSum_univ_pos_eventually :
    ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (1 : ℝ), 0 < primeIdealZetaSum (univ : Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))) s := by
  have hF := tendsto_sub_one_mul_dedekindZeta_nhdsGT K
  have hr : ((dedekindZeta_residue K : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast dedekindZeta_residue_ne_zero K
  have hev := hF.eventually (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hr)
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ := (Ring.not_isField_iff_exists_prime (R := 𝓞 K)).mp
    (RingOfIntegers.not_isField K)
  filter_upwards [hev, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs hs1
  have hζ : dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hs; rw [h0, mul_zero]
  have hsum : LSeriesSummable (fun n ↦ ((Nat.card { I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n } : ℕ) : ℂ)) (s : ℂ) := by
    by_contra hns
    exact hζ (LSeries.eq_zero_of_not_LSeriesSummable _ _ hns)
  have hsm := summable_aux K s hsum
  unfold primeIdealZetaSum
  refine hsm.tsum_pos (fun _ => by positivity) ⟨p, mem_univ _, hp, hp0⟩ ?_
  have : (0 : ℝ) < Ideal.absNorm p := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]; exact hp0)
  positivity
